title: BollyX Fest 2026 | Bollywood Classes & Workshops!
description: Join our CEO, HQ team and instructor community for nonstop Bollywood dancing AS SEEN ON SHARK TANK! No experience needed, all ages welcome.
long_description:
Join our CEO, HQ team and instructor community for nonstop Bollywood dancing AS SEEN ON SHARK TANK! No experience needed, all ages welcome.

About this Event

BollyX Fest brings our global community of BollyX instructors, senior leadership, and class participants together for an exhilarating weekend full of nonstop dancing! This year, we're bringing BollyX Fest back to Austin, Texas at Asian American Resource Center (8401 Cameron Rd) and you're invited to be part of the magic! 🌟

🗓 SCHEDULE
Friday, December 11th
5:00-6:00 pm Instructor Community Meet & Greet 🤗6:00-8:30 pm BollyX Dance Party led by our Instructor community (Open to General Public) 🎶9:00-12:00 am Team outing TBD! 💫

Saturday, December 12th
9:00-11:00 am HQ Masterclass led by our CEO & Leadership Team (Open to General Public) 🔥11:00-12:00 pm Lunch 🌯12:00-3:00 pm Upskilling Workshops (Instructor Community) 💪🏽5:00-9:00 pm Lost Pines Christmas Parade - BollyX Style 😎🎉10:00 pm-2:00 am Afterparty venue TBD! 💃🕺

Please note: location for Saturday Masterclass & Workshops will all be at the AARC (same venue as Friday). The parade, however, will be located in Bastrop (40-minute drive away, with carpools available for our instructors!). Upskilling Workshop agenda will be announced shortly. These power-packed sessions will be led by our CEO and Leadership Team 💫

Sunday, December 13th
10:00-1:00 pm: Chai, Chill & Reel @ Auditorium Shores Downtown Austin

Attending Virtually
Unfortunately, we can’t offer access to this event virtually. However, if you’d like to connect remotely, tune into our Instagram at instagram.com/bollyxfitness as we share stories throughout the weekend! We can’t wait to see you there!

🎟 TICKETS

🎉 *Dance Party and Mega Masterclass are open to the public!*
